dct_alternative_sm: "Geographia" new map of India, Ceylon & Afghanistan
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by hachures and spot heights.

Map of South Asia showing India, Ceylon & Afghanistan, international, state, and district boundaries, railways open, scenes of battles, steamer routes with distances in nautical miles, transportation, water features and populated places.
Insets include indexes for density of population and economics of mining and minerals in India, Ceylon & Afghanistan.
Insets: Density of population [India, Ceylon & Afghanistan]. Scale approximately 1:35,405,568 -- Economics [India, Ceylon & Afghanistan]. Scale approximately 1:28,968,192.
